description: Source code implementing time-related functions such as getting current ticks, converting between timespec and ticks, and formatting time strings, specific to the 'os_time' module.

methods.name: ticks
methods.description: Returns the current time in ticks using CLOCK_MONOTONIC.

methods.name: clock_ticks
methods.description: Returns the current clock ticks for a specified clock.

methods.name: timespec_to_ticks
methods.description: Converts a timespec structure to ticks.

methods.name: ticks_to_timespec
methods.description: Converts ticks to a timespec structure.

methods.name: time_monotonic
methods.description: Returns the current monotonic time in seconds.

methods.name: time_real
methods.description: Returns the current real time in seconds.

methods.name: clock_real_ms
methods.description: Returns the real time in milliseconds.

methods.name: clock_mono_ms
methods.description: Returns the monotonic time in milliseconds.

methods.name: clock_mono_usec
methods.description: Returns the monotonic time in microseconds.

methods.name: clock_mono_double
methods.description: Returns the monotonic clock as a double in seconds.

methods.name: clock_sleep
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified amount of time in seconds.

methods.name: time_to_str
methods.description: Converts a time_t to an ISO 8601 string in GMT.

methods.name: time_from_str
methods.description: Parses an ISO 8601 string into a time_t.

methods.name: ev_clock
methods.description: Returns a monotonic clock in double format, falling back to real time if monotonic is unavailable.
